description: This file defines an interface for a visitor pattern used to process different types of FieldExpression objects within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.query.expression.visitors package. It extends other visitor interfaces and declares methods for visiting various kinds of fields.

classes.name: FieldExpressionVisitor
classes.description: A generic interface for visiting different types of FieldExpression objects, supporting compositional visitor patterns with methods to visit attribute, feature, feature with property, and simple field expressions.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Visit an attribute field with the given key.

methods.name: visitFeature
methods.description: Visit a feature by its ID.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Visit a feature with a specific property, identified by featureId and property.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Visit a simple field with the given field name.
